decision_conditions: No material change of use would have taken place from the current lawful use within Class C3(a) of that Order.
Planning permission will not be required for a use of the nature described as part of the information submitted with this application operating from this address.

However, it is worth noting that should the circumstances relating to the business alter in any respect this may change the requirements for planning permission and you should contact the Council for confirmation of these matters. The onus remains on the applicant to ensure that the development is lawful and that the use of the property remains as a single dwelling house.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for proposed use of one room within the residential dwelling (Use Class C3) as a home office for business administration purposes.
